name: Brackets_Benchmark
description: Benchmark of bracket-related tasks evaluating a model's ability to handle bracket matching, nesting, and completion. It typically consists of synthetic or generated sequences where the correct bracket structure must be predicted or validated, measuring robustness on syntactic sequence completion.
evaluation_method: exact_match / accuracy (correct bracket completion or validation)
reputation: Small, specialized benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited community visibility; useful for targeted tests of syntactic/structural abilities.
